body.name: \(K_{\mathcal I}\)
body.construction: Form \(J_{\mathcal I}=\langle\mathcal C_1(\mathcal I),\sum_zp_z-1\rangle\), saturate by \(s=\prod_zp_z\prod_{D,y}B_{D,y}\), and take \(K_{\mathcal I}=\sqrt[\mathbb R]{J_{\mathcal I}:s^{\infty}}\) over rational polynomials with a fixed-order canonical basis.
